insights.one_liner: NIBC is a Hague-based asset-financing bank of around 700 people, just taken over by ABN AMRO; an IND visa sponsor.

culture.text: Finances housing, rental and commercial real estate and infrastructure; around 700 people, headquartered in The Hague.
Staff mostly studied economics, business and finance, often at Erasmus, The Hague University of Applied Sciences, VU or Leiden.

open.text: NIBC Bank N.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a mid-level product/project role in The Hague, doesn't require Dutch.

growth.text: LinkedIn lists 806 employees, while the company says it employs around 700.
Published its Interim Report 2026 in August.

worth_knowing.text: ABN AMRO completed its takeover of NIBC for €875 million, the biggest Dutch bank acquisition in years.
ABN AMRO has joined NIBC's supervisory board after the deal.
